summary: Commercial dispute settlement among borrower/flat owners, builder, and bank; loan recall notice challenged as unfair trade practice; RBI guidelines violation alleged; 30% pre-EMI discount by bank; 50% pre-EMI borne by builder; principal amount settlement; interest calculation up to 2024-11-30; adjustment of pre-EMI paid by borrowers against 5% sale consideration; appeals disposed with settlement terms.
final_judgment: Appeals disposed of in terms of settlement; bank to waive charges and grant 30% pre-EMI discount; builder to pay 50% pre-EMI; interest fixed up to 2024-11-30; adjustment of pre-EMI against 5% sale consideration directed.
